data.content_ref: inline:The target fails to propose a substantive relation as required by the problem context. Instead of naming a specific kind of relation (e.g., dependence, reduction) and stating what it is refuted if, the target provides a meta-commentary on a supposed contradiction with an external source (SRC_004). The content describes a logical scenario involving 'category mistake' defenses but does not instantiate the requested 'SUBSTANTIVE relation' between the isolated node and its neighbourhood. Consequently, it violates the core instruction to 'propose a SUBSTANTIVE relation... naming its kind'.
